llm.summary: The skill appears to be a purpose-aligned deep-research assistant, but users should expect extensive external web searching and content extraction when they invoke it.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is comprehensive research, and the described capabilities—web search, website/PDF extraction, source verification, and report synthesis—fit that purpose. The main user-noticeable issue is the intentionally high-volume target of 100+ sources.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow is autonomous and iterative, including loops until research saturation and up to 10 concurrent searches. This is coherent for deep research but may be time-, cost-, or rate-limit-intensive.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or required binaries are declared. The included Python files are packaging/validation utilities and are not shown as install-time or runtime steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No credentials, environment variables, or local file access are requested. External web/search/content-extraction use is disclosed and proportional to the research purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The provided artifacts do not show persistent background activity, credential/session use, privilege escalation, or durable memory writes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill looks coherent for deep research and does not show malicious behavior in the provided artifacts. Before using it, remember that it is designed to perform broad external searches and extract many web/PDF sources, so avoid confidential prompts unless your external search and extraction tools are approved for that data. The provided SKILL.md excerpt is truncated, so review the full skill text if available before installation.

evidence.explanation: The skill directs the agent to make many web-search and content-extraction calls. This is central to the stated deep-research purpose, but users should be aware of the volume and autonomy of tool use.
evidence.snippet: Tools Used: `batch_web_search`, `extract_content_from_websites` ... Run independent searches in parallel (up to 10 concurrent queries) ... Source minimum: 100 unique URLs successfully extracted

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use it for tasks where broad research is intended, and consider giving source-count, time, domain, or cost limits for smaller or sensitive tasks.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A research request may trigger many external searches and page/PDF fetches, which can take time and may hit service limits or incur tool/provider costs depending on the environment.

evidence.explanation: The workflow necessarily sends research queries and selected URLs/content through external web/search/content-extraction tooling or websites. This is expected for a research agent, but the artifacts do not define privacy or retention boundaries for those providers.
evidence.snippet: Execute parallel searches across all primary query dimensions ... Access each promising URL ... Parse PDF documents for detailed data

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Avoid including secrets, private client data, or non-public business details in research prompts unless the connected search/extraction tools are approved for that data.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If a user includes confidential or sensitive information in the research question, it may be exposed through external search or extraction requests.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses autonomous, high-volume web research tooling, which is purpose-aligned but should be user-scoped.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, privileged account access, or elevated local permissions are requested in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: Research queries and URLs may be sent to external search/content-extraction providers as part of the intended workflow.
